content.title: Coachella 2026 live updates on special guests, from Becky G to Nav
content.text: 11:58 pm PT April 12, 2026BIGBANG reunites at Coachella for first show since 2017Shad PowersKnown as one of the bands that helped usher in the K-pop boom, BIGBANG reunited Sunday night at Coachella to perform a show together for the first time since 2017, though the band was scheduled to play Coachella in 2020 before it was wiped out by the COVID pandemic.The three primary members — G-Dragon, Taeyang and Daesung — were back together with their high-energy antics, dipping in and out of Korean and English throughout the set that had a large crowd enrapt and singing every lyric at the Outdoor Theatre.At times during their hour-long set, the three members also did solo performances as each also has had a substantial solo career. This won't be the last time they will perform together. The Coachella set is the unofficial starting point of a worldwide tour, but the dates and cities have not yet been revealed.11:42 pm PT April 12, 2026Anyma takes Do Lab stage, doesn't immediately address Friday cancellationPaul Albani-BurgioAnyma finally took the stage at Coachella Sunday night, nearly 48 hours after originally scheduled. But it wasn't the Main Stage the Italian-American DJ was playing but rather the Do LaB after a B2B set featuring Anyma and Marlon Hoffstadt was added to the lineup for the space that serves as the festival's EDM epicenter.Anyma, of course, had originally been scheduled to debut a much-hyped new show Friday before wind and safety concerns led Coachella to cancel the performance. The DJ posted a lengthy message to fans on social media in which he said that the show's debut would now come during Weekend 2 because there was not a time slot available on the Main Stage to perform it.Many in the large crowd, which was spilling beyond the immediate Do LaB area, had their phones out to capture the moment as Anyma and Hoffstadt began their set. Twenty five minutes into what was scheduled to be a 75 minute set, neither Anyma or Hoffstadt, who appeared to be all smiles, had spoken a word into their mics leaving fans to wait and see if Anyma would say anything further about the cancellation.10:47 pm PT April 12, 2026Karol G brings out Mariah Angeliq, Becky G, WisinNiki KottmannKarol G knows how to make an entrance. Although she was 30 minutes late, she wasted no time with her history-making set, and brought out her first special guest, Mariah Angeliq, within the first 15 minutes to sing their song 'El Makinon.'Later in the set, Karol G brought out Mexican-American singer (and Coachella regular) Becky G to sing their song "Mamiii," which the pair also sang together during Karol G's Coachella debut in 2022.Then, there was a long section of the set in which Karol G brought out Puerto Rican rapper/singer Wisin — one half of the iconic reggaeton duo Wisin & Yandel — to sing four of the duo's songs.10:34 pm PT April 12, 2026Karol G begins her headlining set 30 minutes lateShad PowersKarol G, who made history Sunday as the first Latina headliner in Coachella history, didn't start her set until 10:25 p.m., exactly a half hour later than her scheduled start time of 9:55 p.m.Workers were spotted still on the stage setting things up several minutes after the set start time, and multiple crowd members in the front row were chanting “Si se puede” to encourage them.It got people in the audience antsy, and someone was heard saying “she’s on Colombian time.”The curfew for performers on Sunday night is midnight, so it's not clear if Karol G will have to cut some of her planned two-hour show or if she will just go over the time deadline and incur a fine.10:26 pm PT April 12, 2026Icelandic songstress Laufey could headline Coachella, she's that goodShad PowersHer name doesn't rhyme with toffee or taffy, it's actually pronounced LAY-vay, but the 26-year-old prodigy from Iceland put on such a soulful, confident, creative performance Sunday at the Outdoor Theatre at Coachella, that's it's impossible not to foresee huge things in her future.And that could include a Coachella headlining. Before you say it's crazy, remember that a quarter of all female Coachella headliners have been Icelandic (Bjork twice).Laufey, whose sound is a throwback to an era of jazz and bossa nova, played guitar, piano and cello throughout her hour-long set. She has the charisma, pipes and flair to pull off a cinematic Lady Gaga Coachella 2025-esque show.Her closing message for her fans — and all the creatives watching — on Sunday was particularly powerful."It doesn't matter what kind of art you make, there's an audience for it," she said. "Stick to what makes you unique. I'm raised on classical and jazz, and I never would've imagined playing a festival like this — yet here we are at Coachella. What an honor."The honor will be ours when she headlines in, let's say, 2029.9:41 pm PT April 12, 2026FKA twigs transforms Mojave tent into ballroom sceneEma SasicEnglish songstress FKA twigs turned the Mojave tent into a pulse-pounding New York City ballroom club, captivating and impressing at every turn.The ethereal singer began her set rising from a comfy bed, looking angelic as she sang "meta angel." Her stage design was fairly simple, but there were touches added that made everything pop. A shadow from a dancer with large, white wings was projected behind the singer, adding to the airy vibe, while flashing lights got the audience in the club scene.From then, FKA twigs did not let up with the showmanship. Her voice was astounding, effortlessly hitting the delicate high notes on "Eusexua." But her dancing is truly a wonder to witness. Whether she was in-sync with her dancers for an avant-garde piece or showing off her flexibility, you can't help but be in awe of all that she does.Even when FKA twigs was off the stage for a costume change — which there were multiple, like a matching white tank top and underwear and a black gothic gown with red spikes sticking up from the back — her impressive troupe of dancers kept the party going. Once they broke out into a ballroom scene, it was madness inside the Mojave, with the crowd jumping and screaming at all the voguing and death drops.9:36 pm PT April 12, 2026Iggy Pop thrills Mojave crowdBrian BlueskyeIggy Pop brought “Raw Power” to the Mojave on Sunday night, and the 78‑year‑old icon showed up with an impressive live band behind him, which included Yeah Yeah Yeahs' guitarist Nick Zinner, Interpol bassist Brad Truax, The Armed’s Urian Hackney on drums, and Joan Wasser (Joan As Police Woman) on keys.The set was packed with highlights: a full‑throated crowd sing-along during “The Passenger,” “I Wanna Be Your Dog,” “Gimme Danger,” “Lust for Life,” and plenty more.Even as his scoliosis has become more visible in recent years, he’s still performing shirtless, still prowling the stage, and still delivering the kind of raw, high‑energy rock show that only Iggy Pop can.9:35 pm PT April 12, 2026Black Flag set shows skill but lacks spiritBrian BlueskyeThe Los Angeles hardcore punk band Black Flag has endured many lineup changes since forming in 1976, featuring different eras under frontmen such as Henry Rollins, Keith Morris and Ron Reyes.But in 2025, guitarist Greg Ginn announced another reformation featuring significantly younger musicians from the area near where he now lives in Texas. That was the lineup that performed on Sunday in the Gobi tent during the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.When the band opened with "Can't Decide" followed by the classic "Nervous Breakdown," watching the 71-year-old Greg Ginn perform alongside vocalist Max Zanelly, bassist David Rodriguez, and drummer Bryce Weston felt nothing like Black Flag. However, the musicianship of Ginn and the rest of the band was exceptional.Attendance at the Gobi was decent, but it consisted of curious onlookers with skepticism, those indifferent who moshed or screamed along to the lyrics of “Six Pack” and “My War” for the hell of it, spectators who peeked in and left, some who wanted to give it a chance, and others who walked away in disgust.8:18 pm PT April 12, 2026Young Thug set features Ty Dolla $ign, Camila Cabello, Nav, drone showShad PowersRapper Young Thug kicked off his Sunday night main stage set with a drone show that started out as a huge red sphere, then devolved into a sparkly cloud. Then, when the music started, the drones popped to life again in a static version of his YSL logo ("Young Stoner Life," not "Yves Saint Laurent"), which stayed there through the first three songs and then sprinkled away.Young Thug was joined on stage by Ty Dolla $ign to start the show with "Carnival," and four songs in, Camila Cabello popped up to sing her megahit "Havana."The special guests continued when Young Thug brought out Canadian rapper Nav to perform the live debut of their song "Trimski."8:15 pm PT April 12, 2026Foster the People channels Palm Springs mid-modEma SasicIndie rock band Foster the People returned to Coachella after 12 years on Sunday, and it was clear the crowd missed them dearly.From the first notes of their opener, "Helena Beat," one of their many throwback songs throughout the set, viewers were locked into their set and singing along to all the words. While I admit I haven't kept up with the band much since their breakout in the early 2010s, others in the crowd have followed this group through thick and thin.What really stood out to this Palm Springs resident wasn't frontman Mark Foster's pitch-perfect voice, but rather their mid-century modern backdrop. A home that could very easily make it onto Modernism Week's feature home tours was behind them, featuring a butterfly roof and plenty of color. A 1960s "nuclear family" also appeared on screen a number of times throughout the set.Right before the group went into their explosive hit, "Pumped Up Kicks," Foster spoke directly to the many artists in the crowd, both those who have found success and those still trying to find their footing. About a year and a half before the group made its Coachella debut in 2012, he said he was considering quitting music after years of being a struggling musician. But then everything changed once "Pumped Up Kicks" came out.In dark times, Foster said that people turn to artists for comfort, and he encouraged people to continue sharing their point of view and voice.7:36 pm PT April 12, 2026Suicidal Tendencies band brings out ThundercatNiki KottmannLos Angeles heavy metal group Suicidal Tendencies rocked the worlds of those in their Mojave tent audience early Sunday evening when they brought out fellow Angeleno Thundercat, aka singer/producer/bassist Stephen Lee Bruner, to perform with them.7:30 pm PT April 12, 2026Major Lazer Coachella 2026 set features M.I.A.Niki KottmannMajor Lazer, aka the electronic music project of record producer Diplo, DJs Walshy Fire and Ape Drums and vocalist America Foster, tore up the Coachella Stage late Sunday afternoon and brought out British singer/rapper M.I.A. to sing "Paper Planes."6:16 pm PT April 12, 2026Anyma, Isaiah Rashad to play surprise Do Lab set on SundayEma SasicAfter Anyma's much-hyped new ÆDEN show was canceled on Friday, April 10, many festivalgoers were bummed to miss out on the DJ.Well there's a silver lining in their woes: the Do Lab announced Anyma will hold a surprise set in the electronic dance area. The performance will begin at 10:45 p.m. Sunday.Fans should not hold their breath for an ÆDEN performance during the Do Lab set, however, as the DJ announced on Saturday that there was not a slot available to do the set. They will have to tune into Weekend 2's livestream instead.Marlon Hoffstadt will also perform in the Do Lab later this evening, and Isaiah Rashad was also added to the lineup, and is performing as we speak.Anyma was originally scheduled to debut his new show on the main Coachella Stage Friday night, only for the festival to make a last-minute decision to cancel the show because of winds in the area and concerns for audience safety.5:40 pm PT April 12, 2026Clipse brings out special guest Travis BarkerNiki KottmannClipse, the Grammy Award-winning rap duo comprised of brothers Pusha T and Malice, brought out Blink-182 drummer Travis Barker for their Sunday afternoon set at the Outdoor Theatre.5:38 pm PT April 12, 2026Wet Leg Coachella 2026 set features horsegiirLNiki KottmannEnglish Indie rock band Wet Leg brought a familiar face — sort of — onstage during their Coachella main stage debut Sunday. The DJ/singer horsegiirL, who also appeared during PinkPantheress' Saturday Coachella set, came out to jam with the girls in her signature mask.4:46 pm PT April 12, 2026The Chats perform wild early afternoon show in the Gobi tentBrian BlueskyeAn afternoon time slot — especially 3 p.m. — on the Sunday of any Coachella weekend is typically considered early, but fans who arrived to see the Australian punk band The Chats were eager to party. From start to finish, their performance was wild. The band's songs are rowdy and brash, leaving no room for subtlety. Frontman Eamon Zambia Sandwith asked the crowd to scream a tawdry message in unison with him for those livestreaming at home, which many did and some with their middle fingers in the air. Fans were also moshing throughout the show.4:23 pm PT April 12, 2026What time is BIGBANG performing at Coachella?Niki KottmannBeloved K-pop group BIGBANG will reunite for the first time since 2020 at Coachella 2026, and their Sunday set will be streamed at 10:30 p.m. PDT on the official YouTube Coachella livestream.3:36 pm PT April 12, 2026Did it just rain at Coachella? Yes, but it stopped before I could finish writing thisPaul Albani-Burgio and Shad PowersThe skies darkened toward the west Sunday afternoon and then briefly delivered something that has not been seen at Coachella in quite some time: rain.At around 3 p.m., a few drops of rain were felt in the press tent. But then, just as quickly as it started, the rain seemed to stop with nary a sign it had happened at all.But while the rain provided a momentary novelty, the bigger weather concerns for the rest of the day were likelier to be wind and relatively cool temperatures that could drop into the mid-50s by the time the festival was wrapping up.The National Weather Service was forecasting winds of 10 to 15 mph and gusts of up to 30 mph for Sunday evening and into Monday, meaning campers could be left to contend windy conditions as they dismantle their sites and head out Monday morning.2:07 pm PT April 12, 2026Karol G headlines on rare chilly April day in Indio as Coachella Day 3 is off to windy startShad PowersThe final day of the first weekend is upon us with a breezy start to a day that will conclude with a history-making performance of Karol G as the first Latina headliner.At 2 p.m., there were 20 mph winds whipping through the polo grounds and a high temperature forecast for 77 degrees. For comparison, the high in Indio on April 12 in 2025 was 100 degrees, in 2024 it was 90 and in 2023 it was 91 degrees.The low temperature Sunday night is slated to be 59 degrees, and if it's still windy, we could be using the phrase "wind-chill factor" at Coachella for the first time at the desert festival.2:32 am PT April 12, 2026Car erupts in flames in Red Lot as Coachella festivalgoers are trying to leaveAndy Abeyta and Niki KottmannThree Desert Sun journalists were trying to exit Red Lot, the Coachella festival day parking lot next to the campgrounds, early Sunday morning when they noticed smoke coming from behind them.Soon, two firetrucks and several police cars (somehow) squeezed between traffic and got into the lot to take control of a white BMW that was on fire. Two engines arrived, and the fire is now out.No injuries were reported, and the vehicle owner was safe and on site.11:10 pm PT April 11, 2026The Strokes deliver the best set of Coachella 2026 (so far)Paul Albani-BurgioWere The Strokes too much for Coachella's sound system? That’s the conclusion I came to after their thrilling Coachella show was interrupted by several ever-so-brief instances of the sound system cutting out, only to be restored within a second or two.The issue did nothing to detract from what was a truly thrilling show. On the contrary, it only seemed to emphasize how absolutely rocking it was. My Desert Sun colleagues and I have seen dozens of Coachella sets on the main stage between us, and we all agreed we could not recall another set that came anywhere close to matching the sheer volume with which The Strokes hits (and a few deeper cuts) were being blasted through the speakers.It was the perfect way to see one of the great bands of the early 2000s, who also took advantage of Coachella’s ability to create a spectacle to accompany several of their tunes with a hypnotic barrage of lasers.The classic tune “Someday” which was accompanied not by lasers but by a nostalgic-feeling video of sights from the band’s hometown of New York, was an early highlight of the show. I also cherished hearing The Strokes’ biggest hit from their most recent album, “The Adults are Talking,” which sounded even better live than I would’ve expected.But the true showstopper was, of course, “Reptilia” which saw the band take full advantage of the booming speakers and lasers at their disposal to deliver the best performance of a song I have heard at Coachella this year.10:33 pm PT April 11, 2026Precious Renee Tucker, The Dare, horsegiirL come onstage with PinkPantheressEma SasicBritish singer-songwriter PinkPantheress created a club house vibe inside the Mojave tent Saturday, and she got a few friends to help her out with it too.Among those on her "VIP" list were Precious Renee Tucker, who helped play the piano on "Pain" toward the beginning of PinkPantheress' set.Later on, as the club continued to get more lit, a few more famous faces popped up. The Dare came out to play a remix of Addison Rae's "Fame is a Gun" and Charli XCX's "Guess" while PinkPantheress did a costume change into a new outfit including at top with a huge bow on it. DJ horsegiirL was also spotted on stage as a fake club scene emerged and certain people were being allowed "inside."Actor Tyriq Withers appeared as a special guest a couple times during her set, playing Romeo. The two appeared to end the set with an onstage kiss, although a sign with the words "The End" blocked the audiences' view.10:30 pm PT April 11, 2026David Guetta Coachella set featured hits to fire up the Quasar crowdSam MorgenSometimes keeping it simple is the best option. That was the case for David Guetta at the Quasar Stage Saturday night. The French DJ played a succession of EDM remixes of popular songs, firing up the crowd into an energetic frenzy.What do the songs "Day 'n' Nite" by Kid Cudi, "Satisfaction" by Benny Benassi, "Guess" by Charli XCX and "Club Can't Handle Me" by Flo Rida have in common?The answer is, you guessed it, they were all played in sequences by Guetta during this Coachella set.That was just a sampling of the Top 40 hits mixed into Guetta's roughly two-hour performance. The DJ put on a clinic on hyping up the crowd, exhibiting the talents that have allowed him to amass more than 30 billion streams on Spotify.The 58-year-old said it had been 10 years since he last played at Coachella. It felt like he'd never left.10:25 pm PT April 11, 2026Labrinth Coachella set starts off weird, loses the audienceEma SasicAfter Labrinth posted a very cryptic message on social media a few weeks ago — saying he was "done with this industry" — many were wondering what on earth he'd do during his Coachella set.Well, we can now report that he went a little weird.A graphic popped up on the screen saying in order for one to heal, they have to sit with the internal chaos. It was followed by a graphic of the singer free falling. So, clearly off to a great start.For the first 15 minutes of his set, a masked Labrinth was seen inside some type of industrial cage contraption on stage. Honestly, it was hard to make out what was going on, especially because we couldn't actually see his face (for a second I didn't even know if it was him on stage) and the graphics on screen were animated and often not clear. He didn't call out to the audience at all during that time, so it mainly felt like he was going through the motion.Finally, when he removed his mask and slowly started coming out of the cage, the artistic and creative Labrinth took over. His powerful vocals took center stage, and the visuals continued to entice. At one point, he had a camera attached to his microphone, and we all got an up-close-and-personal look at the singer.Perhaps the upside of this performance came a bit too late for festivalgoers, as several were seen continuously leaving the set. Once The Strokes began their performance at the Coachella Stage, however, their speakers drowned out Labrinth's set, leading to even more people exiting.9:42 pm PT April 11, 2026Geese prompts an early Justin Bieber singalongSam MorgenThe Brooklyn-band Geese prompted an early Justin Bieber singalong by covering one of the singer's biggest hits hours before the headliner was set to take the stage.During a sunset performance in the Gobi Theater, Geese rocked out in their idiosyncratic style. About 15 minutes into their set, they broke into Bieber's 2010 hit, "Baby." While the crowd had been swaying appreciatively during the beginning of the set, they started cheering and singing along at the start of "Baby."It might say something about the band that one of the biggest moments of their Coachella set was a song from another artist, but the crowd didn't seem to care. It was a smart choice and it paid off. Maybe next time they'll get the crowd going with one of their own songs.9:37 pm PT April 11, 2026Nine Inch Noize Coachella set proves visually stunning, hauntingBrian BlueskyeThe Saturday performance by Nine Inch Noize, a collaboration between Nine Inch Nails and Boys Noize, featured a haunting, surreal, and intense musical and visual production. Before the performance began, a large, tilted triangle with a platform at its center was set up on the Sahara stage. When the music began, the red lighting and blend of industrial and dark electronic music began, featuring a reimagining of Nine Inch Nails’ sound and the two recent collaborations on the “TRON: Ares” and “Challengers” soundtracks.When a group of dancers repeatedly climbed up and slid down the triangular structure that resembled a volcano, a pyramid in an apocalyptic sky, or other various settings, it made the 45-minute performance more stirring. The set included some Nine Inch Nails classics such as “Heresy,” “Closer,” and “Copy of A.” The visual effects and electronic music presentation was a perfect performance for the Sahara tent, but the stage's overwhelming bass featured in DJ sets took away from the vocals.8:26 pm PT April 11, 2026Sombr brings out Billy Corgan, shows rock star sideEma SasicWhether you went into Sombr's set knowing his songs or were just curious about this Timothée Chalamet/Finn Wolfhard-looking man, chances are you left as a fan.The Grammy-nominated pop rocker had the crowd in the palm of his hand from the start. I mean, when you step out in a black leather jacket and pants and wearing a black lace shirt underneath, who wouldn't want to be in your corner?Sombr looked good and sounded incredible throughout the whole set, pouring his heart out into emotional songs such as "i wish i knew how to quit you" and "potential." And just to show how much the crowd was into him, they obliged to jump for him even when he called all of them "losers" via his video screen.Based on the enormous turnout of festivalgoers of all ages — I even spotted an infant in the crowd — it's clear Sombr is our next rock superstar. But seemingly not wanting to let all the fame go to his head, he brought out legendary Smashing Pumpkins frontman Billy Corgan — making his Coachella debut — to sing the band's hit "1979." Though it was initially plagued with mic issues for Corgan, they bounced back by the time the iconic chorus began.I didn't know too much about your music prior to this set, Sombr, but now, consider me a fan.8:05 pm PT April 11, 2026Royel Otis members rock Mojave during afternoon setBrian BlueskyeThe Australian indie-pop duo Royel Otis drew a full crowd at the Mojave tent on Saturday afternoon. They opened their performance with a humorous video featuring a pink background that welcomed fans to the desert. In the video, they playfully advised attendees not to check their bank accounts the following day and suggested they could sleep through the next week.It was another rock performance proving that there's an upswing on the genre at the festival by established a newer generation of bands. Geese received the same reception in the nearby Gobi tent, and so did SOMBR on the Outdoor Theatre stage.6:29 pm PT April 11, 2026Sabrina Carpenter apologizes after Coachella ‘confusion’Paris BarrazaSabrina Carpenter is facing some criticism online due to an interaction she had with an audience member at Coachella.The moment was captured in a clip that was shared in several posts on X as of April 11. In the clip, a sound seemingly coming from the crowd can be heard among more general audience noise.“Is that what you’re doing?” Carpenter asked.A person can be heard responding, followed by Carpenter saying, “I don’t like it.”The exchange continued. At one point, Carpenter referred to the sound as “yodeling,” and the person could be heard trying to explain. Although the audio is at times a bit weak, words like “culture,” “call” and “celebration” can be heard from the person trying to explain to Carpenter.“Is this Burning Man? What’s going on? This is weird,” the Grammy-winner said.Several users on social media responded to the interaction with explanations of the sound and referred to it as a zaghrouta, a cultural vocalization.Carpenter issued an apology in a post on X. “My apologies I didn’t see this person with my eyes and couldn’t hear clearly,” Carpenter’s post said. “My reaction was pure confusion, sarcasm and not ill intended. Could have handled it better! Now I know what a Zaghrouta is! I welcome all cheers and yodels from here on out.”6:27 pm PT April 11, 2026Coachella livestream schedule 2026? See timesParis BarrazaHere’s the official livestream schedule from Coachella’s Instagram account. Fans can watch on Coachella’s YouTube page, and can download the Coachella Livestream app to explore the replay schedule, according to Coachella.6:23 pm PT April 11, 2026How long does Coachella last?Paris BarrazaThe festival runs for two weekends in April. This year, that’s April 10-12 and April 17-19.The entrance to the festival grounds — not parking, but where performances will be held — opens around 1 p.m. “ish,” according to Coachella. On Fridays and Saturdays, venue curfew (aka when the live music must stop, or else Goldenvoice gets fined) is 1 a.m. both Fridays and Saturdays, and on the Sundays, it’s at midnight, said Coachella.6:19 pm PT April 11, 2026Maddie Ziegler joins Addison Rae at Coachella 2026Paris BarrazaMaddie Ziegler, the actress and former “Dance Moms” star, joined Addison Rae on stage during the Tik Tok-turned-pop star's first Coachella Stage set (or, at least, first as a lineup artist rather than a special guest).The dancer, who has starred in music videos for singer Sia, surprised fans during Rae’s performance of “Aquamarine.” And unsurprisingly, she showed off her talent for dancing throughout the brief appearance.5:18 pm PT April 11, 2026Who's playing at Coachella 2026?Paris BarrazaSabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber and Karol G are headlining the festival this year. But of course, there are numerous performances taking place throughout the festival grounds. On Saturday alone, performers include The Strokes, Addison Rae, David Byrne and Interpol.However, expect performers to bring surprise guests to their sets. This year, we’ve already gotten Lizzo, Snoop Dogg and Joe Jonas. And Coachella itself also throws surprises, too, like the recent addition of Jack White to the lineup.5:17 pm PT April 11, 2026Where's Coachella 2026?Paris BarrazaCoachella is held at the Empire Polo Club at 81-800 Avenue 51 in Indio, California. Indio, which is part of the Coachella Valley, is more than 100 miles southeast of downtown Los Angeles. 4:13 pm PT April 11, 2026Romy to perform surprise Coachella DJ set in Do LaBBrian BlueskyeThe Do LaB stage will feature a special guest DJ set tonight at 7:30 p.m. PDT by The xx guitarist and backing vocalist Romy.The xx reunited for its first full gig together in eight years on Friday, April 3, in Mexico City, and the reunion tour continued Friday, April 10 with its set on the Coachella Stage.Wind conditions on Friday also caused an issue in The Do LaB — supposedly when a light fell during DJ John Summit's surprise set and hit an attendee, but the Do Lab was back up and running as of gates opening Saturday.3:54 pm PT April 11, 2026Beliebers line up at the Coachella Stage hours before headliner set to performSam MorgenAlthough Justin Bieber isn't set to perform until 11:25 p.m., the superstar's biggest fans started lining up in front of the stage just after the gates opened at 1:20 p.m. Dozens of people sat in their Bieber gear, with parasols, in the 80-degree heat Saturday afternoon.Bieber hasn't performed a large-scale concert since the 2022 Justice World Tour (other than his recent Grammys performance), which was canceled when the artist was diagnosed with Ramsay Hunt Syndrome, a neurological symptom that can paralyze the face.The headlining set on Saturday has been billed as Bieber's long-awaited comeback, and the fans are eager to see it.Trinity James and Leah Vanderpool traveled to Indio from Ohio to view the performance. They said they had been fans since they were 13 years old and had promised themselves they would attend Coachella if he headlined."As long as we see him, that is all we need," James, 25, said. "He could stand there and say nothing and that would be OK."The pair have been to four of Beiber's concerts already and said they hoped he would play some old hits, but would be satisfied if he stuck with his newer music. But they have a few more hours to wait before they find out.3:42 pm PT April 11, 2026Coachella DJ set canceled, Do Lab back up and runningNiki Kottmann"Dustchella" caused several issues Friday night, first when a light — likely aided by the wind — supposedly fell during DJ John Summit's surprise set in the Do Lab and hit an attendee. According to several festivalgoers' social media posts, the attendee was injured, and the incident caused organizers to temporarily close the Do Lab.Festival promoter Goldenvoice has not provided an official statement about the incident, and we're waiting for a response to our questions.Later in the night, another DJ set was impacted by the wind. Anyma, the melodic techno project of Italian-American DJ/producer Matteo Milleri, canceled his Friday night closing set on the Coachella Stage, citing wind and concerns for audience safety. The decision, which the official Coachella Instagram account posted about, was made by both the festival and the artist, and was likely linked to the earlier incident in the Do Lab.However, when we were back on the festival grounds around 2 p.m. Saturday, the Do Lab was fully back up and running, with speakers blasting music by producer/ DJ duo Baalti.3:22 pm PT April 11, 2026Strong winds kick up 'Dustchella' conditions across Coachella ValleyJames WardGusty winds and blowing dust are turning Coachella 2026 Weekend 1 into familiar “Dustchella” conditions across the Coachella Valley as a windblown dust advisory remains in effect.Forecasters warn that winds strengthening later in the day could kick up blowing dust, reduce visibility and worsen air quality — especially during evening and overnight hours when festival crowds are at their largest.Air quality levels have reached “unhealthy for sensitive groups,” and even healthy adults may feel irritation in their eyes, throat and lungs during dusty stretches.
